dedupe_keys.name: sherlock a dataset for process aware intrusion detection research on power grid networks

description: Eric Wagner and colleagues publish Sherlock, a labelled power-grid cyber-intrusion benchmark generated with the Wattson co-simulator. Zenodo lists three scenario ZIPs under CC BY 4.0 at no cost and links detailed public documentation. The Basic and Semiurban networks each have attack-free training data and attacked test data; the Rural network supplies a test set for transfer checks. Files include IEC 60870-5-104 network captures, attack and recovery labels, device logs, ground truth and IPAL conversions. They can test cyber-physical attack detection and grid-control resilience models. Coverage is three synthetic grid networks. The related SANDI-2024 catalogue record is a different substation traffic dataset and does not cover Sherlock. A limitation is that the scenarios are co-simulated, not direct measurements of live utility incidents. Training and test network differences can shape apparent generalisation. No archive was downloaded or detector performance reproduced.
